# Placeholders

Grey bars in the shape of content that is on its way — the first load of a page or a panel. A region that already has content and reloads it gets an overlay instead: see [Busy](busy.md).

## Examples

Each bar is a `placeholder` sized by a width utility. They pulse slowly, and stand still for people who ask for less motion.

```html
<section class="card" aria-label="Loading">
	<div class="card-header"><span class="placeholder w-25"></span></div>
	<div class="card-body vstack gap-8">
		<span class="placeholder w-75"></span>
		<span class="placeholder w-50"></span>
		<span class="placeholder w-100"></span>
	</div>
</section>
```

## Accessibility

- Placeholders are empty elements; the region holding them is named "Loading" until the content takes its place.
- Keep the shapes close to the real content, so the page does not jump when it arrives.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/placeholder.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/placeholder.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-border`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placeholder-glow` | — | remove | placeholders pulse by themselves |
| `placeholder-wave` | — | remove | placeholders pulse by themselves |
| `placeholder-xs` | — | review | size by the height of the bar |
